answer_1.quote: We extensively evaluate CodeT5+ on over 20 code-related benchmarks under various settings, including zero-shot, finetuning, and instruction-tuning. Results show substantial gains on many downstream tasks ... 2 retrieval-augmented code generation tasks (+5.8 avg. BLEU-4).
answer_1.outputs: generated source code (functions, programs) and code summaries

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the decoder-only generation capability of CodeT5+ through a line-level code completion task ... we use exact match (EM) accuracy and Levenshtein edit similarity as the metrics. For zero-shot code generation we report pass@k and BLEU-4; for retrieval tasks we report Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR).
